mission: CAD viewing plus a first-class reference-numeral / figure graph for a solo patent practice in professional-desktop.
statusNote: Promoted from reference to active 2026-08-17. The 2026-05-29 buyer's guide was repo-agnostic and 3D-solid-biased; a corpus census (837 DWG vs 201 STEP; 86 of 175 .ai sheets carry extractable 'FIG. n' text) reframed the packet around the 2D figure and its numeral graph. Local-only was relaxed to a per-matter policy and consent record on operator direction: quality first, cloud permitted where better.

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until this goal's work ships as a PR driven to mergeable via /yeet (bun run beep yeet: repair -> verify -> publish --pr -> monitor).

phases.name: Ship to attorney's Windows box, then close

stopConditions: The 37 CFR 1.84(p)(4)-(5) bijection cannot be computed from real corpus files.
DWG support would require linking GPL code or redistributing a converter whose terms forbid it.
A provider's terms conflict with a matter's recorded consent policy.
Verification requires unnamed credentials, cost, destructive side effects, or policy approval.
The same blocker repeats after reasonable investigation.
